[Skip to main content](https://docs.alice.io/api/wondersuite-wonderfence#__docusaurus_skipToContent_fallback)

WonderFence provides real-time guardrails for AI-generated content. APIs for evaluating and moderating AI-generated content and interactions to protect against harmful outputs and prompt attacks.

[GETList policies\\
\\
Lists the WonderFence enforcement policies available to the project, the same catalog the Policies page shows, including vector (custom-model) policies.](https://docs.alice.io/api/list-policies) [GETGet policy-to-application assignments\\
\\
Maps each policy id to the ids of the applications it is enabled for. A policy enabled for no application is absent or maps to an empty list. To get one application's policies, collect the policy ids whose list contains its appId.](https://docs.alice.io/api/get-application-policies) [PUTSet the policies an application has enabled\\
\\
Replaces the whole set of policies enabled for one application, as the Apply Policies page does. To enable or disable a single policy, read the application's current policies from \`GET /wonderfence/application-policies\`, add or remove the policy id, and send the full list. An empty \`policyIds\` disables every policy for the application. Other applications are never affected.](https://docs.alice.io/api/set-policies-for-app) [POSTWonderFence evaluate message\\
\\
Evaluate messages with application-specific policy enforcement. Every request must identify the application with \`app\_id\`; only policies assigned to that application will be applied.](https://docs.alice.io/api/evaluate-wonderfence-message) [POSTEvaluate a Databricks Unity AI Gateway external-policy event\\
\\
External policy endpoint for the Databricks Unity AI Gateway. Configure it on a Unity Catalog HTTP connection and Databricks calls it around every governed model request, sending an \`{event, config}\` envelope and acting on the \`ALLOW\`/\`DENY\` verdict it gets back.](https://docs.alice.io/api/databricks-evaluate)
